scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run -w @easymarket/api start:dev" "npm run -w @easymarket/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w @easymarket/api build && npm run -w @easymarket/web build
scripts.tablet:android:sync: npm run -w @easymarket/web build && npx cap sync android
scripts.db:setup: npm run setup:env && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
